KM1.label: Customer-facing documentation gap

KM1.1.label: Help article missing for this scenario
KM1.1.description: No customer-facing documentation exists covering the specific issue or question the customer had.

KM1.2.label: Existing article inaccurate or outdated
KM1.2.description: A help article exists but contains incorrect, outdated, or misleading information that contributed to the customer's confusion or issue.

KM1.3.label: Article exists but customer could not find it
KM1.3.description: The relevant documentation exists but is not discoverable — poor search, navigation, or categorisation prevented the customer from finding it before contacting support.

KM1.4.label: Step-by-step guide or visual tutorial needed
KM1.4.description: The topic requires visual or step-by-step guidance (screenshots, video, annotated images) that is not currently available.

KM1.description: This interaction reveals that help articles, FAQs, or guides available to customers are missing, inaccurate, or insufficient for the scenario encountered.

KM2.label: FAQ opportunity

KM2.1.label: Common question not in FAQ
KM2.1.description: The customer's question is likely common but is not addressed in the existing FAQ.

KM2.2.label: FAQ answer insufficient or confusing
KM2.2.description: An FAQ entry exists for this question but the answer is incomplete, jargon-heavy, or otherwise unhelpful.

KM2.description: The customer's question or issue represents a frequently asked question that should be added to or improved in the FAQ section.

KM3.label: Internal knowledge or training gap

KM3.1.label: Agent lacked information not in knowledge base
KM3.1.description: The agent could not answer a question because the relevant information is not documented in the internal knowledge base.

KM3.2.label: Internal process documentation unclear
KM3.2.description: The agent was uncertain about internal procedure, suggesting the process documentation is ambiguous, missing, or not accessible in the knowledge base.

KM3.3.label: Agent training gap for this scenario
KM3.3.description: The agent's response suggests they have not been trained on how to handle this type of request.

KM3.description: This interaction reveals a gap in the internal knowledge base, agent runbooks, or training materials that agents rely on.

KM4.label: No knowledge gap identified

KM4.1.label: Existing documentation adequate — no action needed
KM4.1.description: The agent or customer was able to use existing resources effectively. No new or updated content is required.

KM4.description: The interaction did not reveal any documentation or knowledge gap. Existing resources are adequate for this type of enquiry.
